fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook and redfish early/late, pompano, whiting, jacks, Spanish mackerel, flounder (Blind/Stump Pass, beaches). LEMON BAY: redfish schools, mangrove snapper, snook into the ICW. NEARSHORE: red/gag grouper, snapper. Baits: shrimp, soft plastics, live bait, pompano jigs.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis background in one Sarasota sample past week; no fish kills or respiratory irritation. Harbor sites background/none.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (enterococci ~10–20 CFU/100mL). Port Charlotte Beach East poor 238 — not the Key.
